issues.problem: Optional step 4 says that on Apple silicon you can use the arm64 image with qemu-system-aarch64 and -accel hvf, keeping the rest of the command. qemu-system-aarch64 stops with 'No machine specified' unless you pass -machine virt. It also needs -cpu host with hvf and UEFI firmware (-bios edk2-aarch64-code.fd). Followed as written, the macOS/arm64 variant does not boot.
issues.fix: Give the full Apple-silicon command, e.g. `qemu-system-aarch64 -machine virt,accel=hvf -cpu host -m 1024 -nographic -bios $(brew --prefix qemu)/share/qemu/edk2-aarch64-code.fd -drive file=node01.qcow2,if=virtio -nic user,model=virtio-net-pci,hostfwd=tcp::2222-:22 -smbios 'type=1,serial=ds=nocloud;s=http://10.0.2.2:8080/'`, or state that the optional step is only tested on x86_64 Linux with KVM.
